description: This file is a module that manages and generates plugin SDK facades for a project, including listing, resolving, and generating code for facades, as well as managing their types and sources. It also handles import resolution, caching, and code generation for plugin surface modules and their type maps.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeModule
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript module for a plugin SDK facade based on an entry configuration, resolving source modules, imports, and exports, and generating code accordingly.

methods.name: buildPluginSdkFacadeTypeMapModule
methods.description: Generates a TypeScript interface describing the type map for all plugin SDK facades, including modules, sources, and types.

methods.name: listFacadeEntrySourcePaths
methods.description: Returns a unique list of source paths used in a facade entry, including source and export sources.

methods.name: resolveFacadeLoadPolicy
methods.description: Determines the load policy for a given facade entry and source path, defaulting to 'plain' or using specific policies if defined.
